entries.gap: abc -liberty <lib> -D <ps> without -constr: the delay target does not change the mapped netlist.
entries.symptom: Runs with different -D values give the same netlist (the same hash). No warning.
entries.workaround: Compare the netlist hash of two values before you record a delay target as a decision. To change the logic depth, use a depth-oriented ABC script before the mapping, and check the depth with a timing run.
entries.evidence: a 4-tap FIR filter with the IHP SG13G2 typical library: no -D, and -D 100, 1000, 5000 and 20000 give the same netlist
